lower-no-cord-reader.title: rope anchor
lines: An iron pin driven into the rock, and a hand's
length of rope still knotted to it. The cut end is
old and clean: somebody took the rest with them, or
somebody took it from them.
Two knotflax cord will rig a reciprocal rope to the
corresponding lower terrace. First visit both
existing levels and confirm their landings; then
use the ordinary stair controls at the installed
line.
